meta.method: Manual public-web research (official Etsy pages, Etsy Seller Handbook trend report, eRank and EverBee public blog posts, The Knot, BLS, SBA, NAR). No Etsy pages were scraped. Analyst signals are judgements made from the cited evidence and are labelled as such; they are replaced/blended with live Etsy API metrics once an API key is configured.
limitations: No live Etsy search counts, prices, favorites or views were collected (Etsy Open API key not yet configured).
Example competitor listing URLs come from editorial roundups and were not re-verified as still active.
Price ranges marked 'assumption' are not observations.
